172	func cmdMatrix(args []string) int {
173		fs := flagSet("matrix")
174		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Repository root (default: cwd)")
175		subset := fs.String("subset", "", "TerminalBench subset manifest (default: scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset-canary.json)")
176		profilesCSV := fs.String("profiles", "", "Comma-separated benchmark profile ids")
177		harnessesCSV := fs.String("harnesses", "fiz,pi,opencode", "Comma-separated harness adapter names")
178		reps := fs.Int("reps", 3, "Repetitions per harness/profile/task")
179		budgetUSD := fs.Float64("budget-usd", 0, "Matrix budget in USD (0 = no cap)")
180		out := fs.String("out", "", "Output directory (default: benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp> under work-dir)")
181		cellsRoot := fs.String("cells-root", "", "Optional canonical cell root for report/log artifacts; matrix summaries still go under --out")
182		resume := fs.Bool("resume", false, "Skip terminal reports already present under --out")
183		forceRerun := fs.Bool("force-rerun", false, "Rerun every tuple even when a terminal report exists")
184		retryBudgetHalted := fs.Bool("retry-budget-halted", false, "Rerun budget_halted reports while resuming")
185		retryInvalid := fs.Bool("retry-invalid", false, "Rerun cells with non-empty invalid_class (invalid_setup/invalid_provider/invalid_quota/invalid_auth) while resuming")
186		perRunBudgetUSD := fs.Float64("per-run-budget-usd", 0, "Per-run budget cap in USD (0 = no per-run cap)")
187		tasksDir := fs.String("tasks-dir", "", "Path to TB-2 tasks directory; when set, harbor run is used for grading")
188		jobs := fs.Int("jobs", 1, "Number of tuple runs to execute concurrently (default: 1)")
189		var extraEnv repeatStringFlag
190		fs.Var(&extraEnv, "env", "Extra KEY=VALUE environment pair to pass to Harbor/Fizeau; may be repeated")
191		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
192			return 2
193		}
194		if *reps <= 0 {
195			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --reps must be > 0\n", benchCommandName())
196			return 2
197		}
198		if *profilesCSV == "" {
199			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles is required\n", benchCommandName())
200			return 2
201		}
202		if *harnessesCSV == "" {
203			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --harnesses is required\n", benchCommandName())
204			return 2
205		}
206	
207		// Parent context tied to interrupt/SIGTERM. When the bench process
208		// itself is signaled (Ctrl-C or `kill <pid>`) the parent ctx fires,
209		// propagating cancellation into every per-tuple Harbor invocation. Each
210		// Harbor child then gets SIGTERM via cmd.Cancel + WaitDelay, has 60s
211		// to tear down its docker compose stack, and exits cleanly. Without
212		// this, killing bench leaves Harbor children running with their task
213		// containers (the leak we saw earlier in the session).
214		parentCtx, stopSignals := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
215		defer stopSignals()
216	
217		wd := resolveWorkDir(*workDir)
218		subsetPath := *subset
219		if subsetPath == "" {
220			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, defaultMatrixSubset)
221		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(subsetPath) {
222			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, subsetPath)
223		}
224		// One-true-way defaults: when --out is unset, place the matrix summary
225		// inside the canonical fiz-tools-v<N>/ root. When --cells-root is unset,
226		// share the canonical /cells subtree. Tests that pass an explicit --out
227		// (typically a t.TempDir()) opt out via --cells-root staying empty,
228		// which falls through to the legacy in-place fallback (matrixTupleDir
229		// under outDir/cells/...). That preserves test isolation without
230		// leaving a stale "benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp>/" side path
231		// in production runs.
232		outDir := *out
233		if outDir == "" {
234			outDir = filepath.Join(resolveCanonicalFizRoot(wd), "matrix-runs", "matrix-"+time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z"))
235		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(outDir) {
236			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, outDir)
237		}
238		cellRootDir := *cellsRoot
239		if cellRootDir == "" && *out == "" {
240			// --out and --cells-root both unset: full canonical mode.
241			cellRootDir = filepath.Join(resolveCanonicalFizRoot(wd), "cells")
242		} else if cellRootDir != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(cellRootDir) {
243			cellRootDir = filepath.Join(wd, cellRootDir)
244		}
245	
246		profileIDs := splitCSV(*profilesCSV)
247		harnesses := splitCSV(*harnessesCSV)
248		if len(profileIDs) == 0 || len(harnesses) == 0 {
249			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles and --harnesses must not be empty\n", benchCommandName())
250			return 2
251		}
252	
253		subsetData, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
254		if err != nil {
255			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: load subset %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), subsetPath, err)
256			return 1
257		}
258		profiles, err := selectMatrixProfiles(wd, profileIDs)
259		if err != nil {
260			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
261			return 1
262		}
263		if err := os.MkdirAll(outDir, 0o750); err != nil {
264			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: create output dir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
265			return 1
266		}
267	
268		// Resolve harbor binary if tasks-dir is set (enables graded runs via Docker).
269		resolvedTasksDir := *tasksDir
270		if resolvedTasksDir != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(resolvedTasksDir) {
271			resolvedTasksDir = filepath.Join(wd, resolvedTasksDir)
272		}
273		harborBin := ""
274		if resolvedTasksDir != "" {
275			if bin, err := exec.LookPath("harbor"); err == nil {
276				harborBin = bin
277			} else {
278				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --tasks-dir set but harbor not found on PATH\n", benchCommandName())
279				return 1
280			}
281		}
282	
283		// Build the full list of tuples to run.
284		type tupleSpec struct {
285			harness string
286			prof    *profile.Profile
287			rep     int
288			task    termbenchSubsetEntry
289		}
290		var tuples []tupleSpec
291		for _, harness := range harnesses {
292			for _, prof := range profiles {
293				for rep := 1; rep <= *reps; rep++ {
294					for _, task := range subsetData.Tasks {
295						tuples = append(tuples, tupleSpec{harness, prof, rep, task})
296					}
297				}
298			}
299		}
300	
301		concurrency := *jobs
302		if concurrency < 1 {
303			concurrency = 1
304		}
305	
306		type tupleResult struct {
307			report  matrixRunReport
308			skipped bool
309			err     error
310		}
311	
312		results := make([]tupleResult, len(tuples))
313		sem := make(chan struct{}, concurrency)
314	
315		var (
316			mu              sync.Mutex
317			accumulatedCost float64
318			firstErr        error
319		)
320	
321		var wg sync.WaitGroup
322		for i, spec := range tuples {
323			wg.Add(1)
324			go func(i int, spec tupleSpec) {
325				defer wg.Done()
326				sem <- struct{}{}
327				defer func() { <-sem }()
328	
329				mu.Lock()
330				cost := accumulatedCost
331				mu.Unlock()
332	
333				report, skipped, err := runMatrixTuple(matrixTupleOptions{
334					workDir:           wd,
335					outDir:            outDir,
336					cellsRoot:         cellRootDir,
337					harness:           spec.harness,
338					profile:           spec.prof,
339					rep:               spec.rep,
340					task:              spec.task,
341					budgetUSD:         *budgetUSD,
342					perRunBudgetUSD:   *perRunBudgetUSD,
343					accumulatedCost:   cost,
344					resume:            *resume,
345					forceRerun:        *forceRerun,
346					retryBudgetHalted: *retryBudgetHalted,
347					retryInvalid:      *retryInvalid,
348					parentCtx:         parentCtx,
349					tasksDir:          resolvedTasksDir,
350					harborBin:         harborBin,
351					extraEnv:          extraEnvMap(extraEnv),
352				})
353	
354				mu.Lock()
355				results[i] = tupleResult{report, skipped, err}
356				if err != nil && firstErr == nil {
357					firstErr = err
358				}
359				if err == nil && !skipped {
360					accumulatedCost += report.CostUSD
361				}
362				mu.Unlock()
363			}(i, spec)
364		}
365		wg.Wait()
366	
367		if firstErr != nil {
368			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), firstErr)
369			return 1
370		}
371	
372		var runs []matrixRunReport
373		for _, r := range results {
374			runs = append(runs, r.report)
375		}
376	
377		sort.Slice(runs, func(i, j int) bool {
378			return matrixRunKey(runs[i]) < matrixRunKey(runs[j])
379		})
380		output := matrixOutput{
381			GeneratedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
382			SubsetPath:      subsetPath,
383			Profiles:        profileIDs,
384			Harnesses:       harnesses,
385			Reps:            *reps,
386			BudgetUSD:       *budgetUSD,
387			PerRunBudgetUSD: *perRunBudgetUSD,
388			Runs:            runs,
389			Cells:           summarizeMatrixCells(runs),
390			Notes: []string{
391				fmt.Sprintf("concurrency: --jobs %d", concurrency),
392				"adapter_module records the Python adapter path passed by the runner for the harness cell.",
393			},
394		}
395		matrixPath := filepath.Join(outDir, "matrix.json")
396		if err := writeJSONAtomic(matrixPath, output); err != nil {
397			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: write matrix.json: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
398			return 1
399		}
400		fmt.Printf("matrix results: %s\n", matrixPath)
401		return 0
402	}

425	func runMatrixTuple(opts matrixTupleOptions) (matrixRunReport, bool, error) {
426		cellDir := matrixTupleDirFor(opts.outDir, opts.cellsRoot, opts.harness, opts.profile, opts.rep, opts.task.ID)
427		reportPath := filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixReportName)
428		if !opts.forceRerun {
429			if existing, ok, err := loadExistingMatrixReport(reportPath); err != nil {
430				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
431			} else if ok && shouldSkipMatrixReport(existing, opts.resume, opts.retryBudgetHalted, opts.retryInvalid) {
432				return existing, true, nil
433			}
434		}
435	
436		release, err := acquireMatrixLock(filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixLockName))
437		if err != nil {
438			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
439		}
440		defer release()
441	
442		started := time.Now().UTC()
443		report := matrixRunReport{
444			Harness:         opts.harness,
445			ProfileID:       opts.profile.ID,
446			ProfilePath:     opts.profile.Path,
447			ProfileSnapshot: opts.profile.Versioning.Snapshot,
448			FizToolsVersion: fiztools.Version,
449			AdapterModule:   matrixAdapterModule(opts.harness),
450			HarborAgent:     filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("scripts", "benchmark", "harness_adapters", moduleFileName(opts.harness))) + ":Agent",
451			Rep:             opts.rep,
452			TaskID:          opts.task.ID,
453			Category:        opts.task.Category,
454			Difficulty:      opts.task.Difficulty,
455			OutputDir:       cellDir,
456			StartedAt:       started,
457			PricingSource:   profilePricingSource(opts.profile),
458			SamplingUsed:    samplingUsedFromProfile(opts.profile),
459			ModelServerInfo: queryModelServerInfo(opts.profile),
460		}
461	
462		if opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost >= opts.budgetUSD {
463			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
464			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
465			report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, false)
466			report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
467			if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
468				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
469			}
470			return report, false, nil
471		}
472	
473		workDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, "work")
474		if err := os.MkdirAll(workDir, 0o750); err != nil {
475			return matrixRunReport{}, false, fmt.Errorf("create tuple workdir: %w", err)
476		}
477	
478		if opts.harborBin != "" {
479			taskPath, err := resolveMatrixTaskPath(opts.tasksDir, opts.task.ID)
480			if err != nil {
481				report.ProcessOutcome = "install_fail_permanent"
482				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
483				report.Error = err.Error()
484			} else {
485				// Remove any stale Harbor job dir from a prior run before we
486				// invoke harbor again. Harbor (re)creates fiz-<task>-rep<N>/
487				// inside --jobs-dir; if a stale subdir exists from an earlier
488				// run with a different --tasks-dir, Harbor's config.json there
489				// references paths that may no longer exist (or that point at
490				// since-deleted timestamp dirs), and the trial fails with
491				// confusing errors. Wiping ensures a clean Harbor invocation
492				// every retry.
493				jobName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-rep%d", opts.harness, opts.task.ID, opts.rep)
494				staleJobDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, jobName)
495				if _, err := os.Stat(staleJobDir); err == nil {
496					_ = os.RemoveAll(staleJobDir)
497				}
498				harborResult, err := runMatrixHarbor(harborRunOpts{
499					harborBin: opts.harborBin,
500					taskPath:  taskPath,
501					harness:   opts.harness,
502					profile:   opts.profile,
503					jobsDir:   cellDir,
504					jobName:   jobName,
505					repoRoot:  opts.workDir,
506					extraEnv:  opts.extraEnv,
507					parentCtx: opts.parentCtx,
508				})
509				if err != nil {
510					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
511					report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
512					report.Error = err.Error()
513				} else {
514					report.ExitCode = harborResult.exitCode
515					report.Error = harborResult.errText
516					seconds := harborResult.wallSeconds
517					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
518					if harborResult.inputTokens != nil {
519						report.InputTokens = harborResult.inputTokens
520					}
521					if harborResult.outputTokens != nil {
522						report.OutputTokens = harborResult.outputTokens
523					}
524					if harborResult.turns != nil {
525						report.Turns = harborResult.turns
526					}
527					report.CostUSD = harborResult.costUSD
528					if harborResult.reward != nil {
529						report.Reward = harborResult.reward
530						report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
531						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
532					} else if harborResult.exitCode != 0 {
533						report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
534						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
535					} else {
536						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
537						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
538					}
539				}
540				// Read session-jsonl signals (terminated_mid_work + had_llm_request
541				// + reasoning_tokens) from the trial's session jsonl. The harbor
542				// agent (FizeauAgent) writes to <cellDir>/<jobName>/<trial-hash>/
543				// agent/sessions/svc-*.jsonl; glob for the newest since the
544				// trial-hash isn't known up front. Mirrors backfill-terminated-
545				// mid-work.py.
546				tmw, hadReq, reasoning := readSessionSignalsFromCell(filepath.Join(cellDir, jobName))
547				if tmw != nil {
548					report.TerminatedMidWork = tmw
549				}
550				if reasoning != nil {
551					report.ReasoningTokens = reasoning
552				}
553				report.HadLLMRequest = &hadReq
554			}
555		} else {
556			result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
557			if err != nil {
558				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
559				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
560				report.Error = err.Error()
561			} else {
562				report.Command = result.Command.Argv
563				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
564				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
565				report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
566				if result.ExitCode != 0 {
567					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
568					report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
569				}
570				applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
571				if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
572					seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
573					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
574				}
575			}
576		}
577		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
578			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
579		}
580		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
581			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
582		}
583		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
584			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
585		}
586		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
587		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
588			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
589			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
590			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
591			report.Reward = nil
592		}
593		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
594		report.InvalidClass = classifyMatrixInvalid(report)
595		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
596		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
597			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
598		}
599		return report, false, nil
600	}

602	func resolveMatrixTaskPath(tasksDir, taskID string) (string, error) {
603		candidates := []string{
604			filepath.Join(tasksDir, taskID),
605			filepath.Join(tasksDir, "terminal-bench", taskID),
606		}
607		for _, candidate := range candidates {
608			if isMatrixTaskDir(candidate) {
609				return candidate, nil
610			}
611		}
612	
613		nestedRoot := filepath.Join(tasksDir, "terminal-bench", taskID)
614		entries, err := os.ReadDir(nestedRoot)
615		if err == nil {
616			var matches []string
617			for _, entry := range entries {
618				if !entry.IsDir() {
619					continue
620				}

684	func runMatrixHarbor(opts harborRunOpts) (harborRunResult, error) {
685		started := time.Now()
686	
687		apiKeyEnv := opts.profile.Provider.APIKeyEnv
688		if override := strings.TrimSpace(opts.extraEnv["FIZEAU_API_KEY_ENV"]); override != "" {
689			apiKeyEnv = override
690		}
691		apiKeyVal := resolveMatrixAPIKey(opts.repoRoot, opts.profile, apiKeyEnv)
692	
693		args := []string{"run", "--yes", "--path", opts.taskPath}
694		args = append(args, harborAgentArgs(opts.harness)...)
695		args = append(args,
696			"--model", opts.profile.Provider.Model,
697			"--jobs-dir", opts.jobsDir,
698			"--job-name", opts.jobName,
699		)
700		if truthyEnv("HARBOR_FORCE_BUILD") {
701			args = append(args, "--force-build")
702		}
703		// Agent timeout multiplier resolution order (later wins):
704		//   1. Profile YAML's agent_timeout_multiplier (per-lane default)
705		//   2. HARBOR_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER env var (per-invocation override)
706		// Slow local engines (oMLX, vLLM-int4) bake their multiplier into the
707		// profile so individual sweeps don't have to remember to set the env
708		// var. Without this, those lanes truncate mid-tool-call on hard tasks.
709		multiplier := ""
710		if m := opts.profile.AgentTimeoutMultiplier; m > 0 {
711			multiplier = strconv.FormatFloat(m, 'f', -1, 64)
712		}
713		if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("HARBOR_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER")); env != "" {
714			multiplier = env
715		}
716		if multiplier != "" {
717			args = append(args, "--agent-timeout-multiplier", multiplier)
718		}
719		// Do not pass actual API key values through Harbor --ae args. Harbor
720		// includes those args in process listings and exception logs. The Fizeau
721		// Harbor agent resolves FIZEAU_API_KEY_ENV from the Harbor process
722		// environment instead.
723		// Pass provider config so Harbor agents can configure the model endpoint.
724		args = append(args,
725			"--ae", "FIZEAU_BASE_URL="+opts.profile.Provider.BaseURL,
726			"--ae", "FIZEAU_MODEL="+opts.profile.Provider.Model,
727			"--ae", "FIZEAU_PROVIDER="+fizeauProviderEnv(opts.profile),
728		)
729		for _, kv := range envPairs(opts.extraEnv) {
730			args = append(args, "--ae", kv)
731		}
732		// Forward sampling params so fiz reads them via FIZEAU_* env overrides.
733		for _, kv := range samplingEnvPairs(opts.profile) {
734			args = append(args, "--ae", kv)
735		}
736	
737		// Derive from the parent ctx so SIGTERM/SIGINT on the bench process
738		// itself propagates into this Harbor invocation and triggers cmd.Cancel.
739		parentCtx := opts.parentCtx
740		if parentCtx == nil {
741			parentCtx = context.Background()
742		}
743		// Process-level cap on the harbor invocation. This must exceed the
744		// max possible effective per-trial agent timeout (task base × profile
745		// agent_timeout_multiplier) plus harbor's environment/grading overhead,
746		// or the cap kills the run before harbor can timeout the agent
747		// gracefully. TB-2.1 task bases are <=1200s; vidar's 3.7x multiplier
748		// pushes the effective ceiling to ~74min. 150min leaves headroom for
749		// future profile bumps and non-trivial environment setup.
750		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parentCtx, 150*time.Minute)
751		defer cancel()
752		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, opts.harborBin, args...) // #nosec G204 G702 -- harborBin is a validated binary path from config
753		// Send SIGTERM (not the default SIGKILL) on context cancel so Harbor's
754		// `--delete` finalizer can tear down the per-trial docker compose stack.
755		// WaitDelay gives the cleanup 60s before we hard-kill; without this the
756		// task containers leak and pile up across sweeps (observed: 32 leftover
757		// containers after a 21h run, leading to docker-compose port/IP exhaustion).
758		cmd.Cancel = func() error { return cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM) }
759		cmd.WaitDelay = 60 * time.Second
760		// Add repo root to PYTHONPATH so harbor_adapters modules resolve.
761		env := os.Environ()
762		pythonPath := opts.repoRoot
763		for i, e := range env {
764			if strings.HasPrefix(e, "PYTHONPATH=") {
765				pythonPath = opts.repoRoot + string(os.PathListSeparator) + e[len("PYTHONPATH="):]
766				env[i] = "PYTHONPATH=" + pythonPath
767				pythonPath = ""
768				break
769			}
770		}
771		if pythonPath != "" {
772			env = append(env, "PYTHONPATH="+pythonPath)
773		}
774		env = append(env,
775			"FIZEAU_BASE_URL="+opts.profile.Provider.BaseURL,
776			"FIZEAU_MODEL="+opts.profile.Provider.Model,
777			"FIZEAU_PROVIDER="+fizeauProviderEnv(opts.profile),
778		)
779		if apiKeyEnv != "" && apiKeyVal != "" {
780			env = append(env, apiKeyEnv+"="+apiKeyVal)
781		}
782		if apiKeyVal != "" {
783			env = append(env, "FIZEAU_API_KEY="+apiKeyVal)
784		}
785		for _, kv := range envPairs(opts.extraEnv) {
786			env = append(env, kv)
787		}
788		for _, kv := range samplingEnvPairs(opts.profile) {
789			env = append(env, kv)
790		}
791		if harness := strings.TrimSpace(opts.extraEnv["FIZEAU_HARNESS"]); harness != "" {
792			env = append(env, "HARBOR_FIZEAU_HARNESS="+harness)
793		}
794		cmd.Env = env
795		cmd.Dir = opts.repoRoot
796	
797		var combined bytes.Buffer
798		cmd.Stdout = &combined
799		cmd.Stderr = &combined
800		runErr := cmd.Run()
801		wall := time.Since(started).Seconds()
802	
803		exitCode := 0
804		if runErr != nil {
805			var ee *exec.ExitError
806			if errors.As(runErr, &ee) {
807				exitCode = ee.ExitCode()
808			} else {
809				return harborRunResult{}, runErr
810			}
811		}
812	
813		// Find reward.txt written by the Harbor verifier.
814		var reward *int
815		jobOutDir := filepath.Join(opts.jobsDir, opts.jobName)
816		entries, _ := os.ReadDir(jobOutDir)
817		for _, e := range entries {
818			rewardFile := filepath.Join(jobOutDir, e.Name(), "verifier", "reward.txt")
819			data, err := os.ReadFile(rewardFile) // #nosec G304 -- rewardFile is under runner-owned output dir
820			if err == nil {
821				val, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(data)))
822				if err == nil {
823					reward = &val
824				}
825				break
826			}
827		}
828	
829		errText := harborFailureText(jobOutDir, combined.String())
830		if exitCode == 0 && reward != nil && classifyMatrixInvalidText(errText) == "" {
831			errText = ""
832		}
833		inputTokens, outputTokens, turns, costUSD := readHarborTrajectoryMetrics(jobOutDir)
834		return harborRunResult{
835			reward:       reward,
836			exitCode:     exitCode,
837			wallSeconds:  wall,
838			errText:      errText,
839			inputTokens:  inputTokens,
840			outputTokens: outputTokens,
841			turns:        turns,
842			costUSD:      costUSD,
843		}, nil
844	}

846	func harborFailureText(jobOutDir, combined string) string {
847		var parts []string
848		if s := strings.TrimSpace(combined); s != "" {
849			parts = append(parts, s)
850		}
851		_ = filepath.WalkDir(jobOutDir, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
852			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
853				return nil
854			}
855			base := filepath.Base(path)
856			if base != "fiz.txt" && base != "exception.txt" {
857				return nil
858			}
859			data, err := os.ReadFile(path) // #nosec G304 G122 -- path is under runner-owned output dir; WalkDir TOCTOU acceptable for postprocess scan
860			if err != nil {
861				return nil
862			}
863			text := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
864			if text != "" {
865				parts = append(parts, text)
866			}
867			return nil
868		})
869		text := redactBenchmarkSecrets(strings.Join(parts, "\n"))
870		if len(text) > 4000 {
871			// Keep the tail: Python tracebacks place the actual exception
872			// (e.g. "RuntimeError: Docker compose command failed ...") at the end,
873			// and the framework noise above it is what we'd rather drop.
874			text = text[len(text)-4000:]
875		}
876		return strings.TrimSpace(text)
877	}

879	func redactBenchmarkSecrets(text string) string {
880		if text == "" {
881			return ""
882		}
883		patterns := []*regexp.Regexp{
884			regexp.MustCompile(`sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`),
885			regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(OPENAI_API_KEY|OPENROUTER_API_KEY|FIZEAU_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)=\S+`),
886			regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(api_key:\s*)\S+`),
887		}
888		out := text
889		for _, re := range patterns {
890			out = re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(out, func(match string) string {
891				if strings.Contains(match, "=") {
892					key, _, _ := strings.Cut(match, "=")
893					return key + "=<redacted>"
894				}
895				if strings.Contains(match, ":") {
896					key, _, _ := strings.Cut(match, ":")
897					return key + ": <redacted>"
898				}
899				return "<redacted>"
900			})
901		}
902		return out
903	}

913			if err != nil {
914				return nil
915			}
916			var trajectory struct {

918				FinalMetrics struct {
919					TotalPromptTokens     int     `json:"total_prompt_tokens"`
920					TotalCompletionTokens int     `json:"total_completion_tokens"`
921					TotalCostUSD          float64 `json:"total_cost_usd"`

923				} `json:"final_metrics"`
924			}

926				return nil
927			}

930			stepCount := trajectory.FinalMetrics.TotalSteps

933			}
934			inputTokens = &in
935			outputTokens = &out
936			turns = &stepCount
937			costUSD = trajectory.FinalMetrics.TotalCostUSD
938			return filepath.SkipAll
939		})
940		return inputTokens, outputTokens, turns, costUSD
941	}

1217	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
1218		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
1219			return nil, err
1220		}
1221		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
1222		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
1223		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
1224			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600) // #nosec G304 -- path is the matrix lock file path
1225			if err == nil {
1226				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
1227					_ = f.Close()
1228					_ = os.Remove(path)
1229					return nil, werr
1230				}
1231				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
1232					_ = os.Remove(path)
1233					return nil, err
1234				}
1235				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
1236			}
1237			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
1238				return nil, err
1239			}
1240			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
1241			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
1242				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
1243					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
1244				}
1245				continue
1246			}
1247			pid := "unknown"
1248			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
1249				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
1250			}
1251			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
1252		}
1253		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)

1336	// readSessionSignalsFromCell streams the trial's session jsonl and
1337	// returns four signals:
1338	//
1339	//	tmw           : terminated_mid_work — true if last llm.response had
1340	//	                finish_reason in (tool_calls, length, function_call);
1341	//	                false on (stop, end_turn); nil when no llm.response.
1342	//	hadLLMRequest : true when the agent issued at least one llm.request,
1343	//	                whether or not a response came back.
1344	//	reasoningTokens: per-cell sum of usage.reasoning across all llm.response
1345	//	                events. Returns nil when the provider doesn't expose
1346	//	                reasoning_tokens at all (so absent vs explicit-zero are
1347	//	                distinguishable). Captured from data.usage.reasoning
1348	//	                (fizeau-emitted) or data.usage.completion_tokens_details
1349	//	                .reasoning_tokens (raw upstream OpenAI shape).
1350	//
1351	// The combination distinguishes three failure shapes:
1352	//   - tmw set true|false  → model attempted (real graded result)
1353	//   - tmw nil + hadReq true → request fired but no response (provider hang
1354	//     or stream error). Tag invalid_provider.
1355	//   - tmw nil + hadReq false → never even sent a request (setup failure
1356	//     before reaching the model).
1357	//
1358	// jobDir = <cellDir>/<jobName>; harbor writes to
1359	// <jobDir>/<trial-hash>/agent/sessions/svc-*.jsonl.
1360	func readSessionSignalsFromCell(jobDir string) (tmw *bool, hadLLMRequest bool, reasoningTokens *int) {
1361		matches, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(jobDir, "*", "agent", "sessions", "svc-*.jsonl"))
1362		if err != nil || len(matches) == 0 {
1363			return nil, false, nil
1364		}
1365		// Newest by mtime — matches the trial we just ran.
1366		sessPath := matches[0]
1367		if len(matches) > 1 {
1368			newest, _ := os.Stat(sessPath)
1369			for _, m := range matches[1:] {
1370				st, err := os.Stat(m)
1371				if err == nil && (newest == nil || st.ModTime().After(newest.ModTime())) {
1372					sessPath = m
1373					newest = st
1374				}
1375			}
1376		}
1377		f, err := os.Open(sessPath) // #nosec G304 -- jobDir is a benchmark output path
1378		if err != nil {
1379			return nil, false, nil
1380		}
1381		defer f.Close()
1382		var lastFinish string
1383		var reasoningSum int
1384		var sawReasoning bool
1385		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
1386		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 1024*1024), 16*1024*1024)
1387		for scanner.Scan() {
1388			var ev struct {
1389				Type string `json:"type"`
1390				Data struct {
1391					FinishReason string `json:"finish_reason"`
1392					Usage        struct {
1393						Reasoning               int `json:"reasoning"`
1394						CompletionTokensDetails struct {
1395							ReasoningTokens int `json:"reasoning_tokens"`
1396						} `json:"completion_tokens_details"`
1397					} `json:"usage"`
1398				} `json:"data"`
1399			}
1400			if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &ev); err != nil {
1401				continue
1402			}
1403			switch ev.Type {
1404			case "llm.request":
1405				hadLLMRequest = true
1406			case "llm.response":
1407				if ev.Data.FinishReason != "" {
1408					lastFinish = ev.Data.FinishReason
1409				}
1410				// Prefer fizeau's normalized field; fall back to the raw OpenAI shape
1411				// if a provider passes raw upstream usage through unchanged.
1412				tokens := ev.Data.Usage.Reasoning
1413				if tokens == 0 {
1414					tokens = ev.Data.Usage.CompletionTokensDetails.ReasoningTokens
1415				}
1416				if tokens > 0 {
1417					sawReasoning = true
1418					reasoningSum += tokens
1419				}
1420			}
1421		}
1422		switch lastFinish {
1423		case "tool_calls", "length", "function_call":
1424			t := true
1425			tmw = &t
1426		case "stop", "end_turn":
1427			fv := false
1428			tmw = &fv
1429		}
1430		if sawReasoning {
1431			reasoningTokens = &reasoningSum
1432		}
1433		return tmw, hadLLMRequest, reasoningTokens
1434	}

172	func cmdMatrix(args []string) int {
173		fs := flagSet("matrix")
174		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Repository root (default: cwd)")
175		subset := fs.String("subset", "", "TerminalBench subset manifest (default: scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset-canary.json)")
176		profilesCSV := fs.String("profiles", "", "Comma-separated benchmark profile ids")
177		harnessesCSV := fs.String("harnesses", "fiz,pi,opencode", "Comma-separated harness adapter names")
178		reps := fs.Int("reps", 3, "Repetitions per harness/profile/task")
179		budgetUSD := fs.Float64("budget-usd", 0, "Matrix budget in USD (0 = no cap)")
180		out := fs.String("out", "", "Output directory (default: benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp> under work-dir)")
181		cellsRoot := fs.String("cells-root", "", "Optional canonical cell root for report/log artifacts; matrix summaries still go under --out")
182		resume := fs.Bool("resume", false, "Skip terminal reports already present under --out")
183		forceRerun := fs.Bool("force-rerun", false, "Rerun every tuple even when a terminal report exists")
184		retryBudgetHalted := fs.Bool("retry-budget-halted", false, "Rerun budget_halted reports while resuming")
185		retryInvalid := fs.Bool("retry-invalid", false, "Rerun cells with non-empty invalid_class (invalid_setup/invalid_provider/invalid_quota/invalid_auth) while resuming")
186		perRunBudgetUSD := fs.Float64("per-run-budget-usd", 0, "Per-run budget cap in USD (0 = no per-run cap)")
187		tasksDir := fs.String("tasks-dir", "", "Path to TB-2 tasks directory; when set, harbor run is used for grading")
188		jobs := fs.Int("jobs", 1, "Number of tuple runs to execute concurrently (default: 1)")
189		var extraEnv repeatStringFlag
190		fs.Var(&extraEnv, "env", "Extra KEY=VALUE environment pair to pass to Harbor/Fizeau; may be repeated")
191		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
192			return 2
193		}
194		if *reps <= 0 {
195			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --reps must be > 0\n", benchCommandName())
196			return 2
197		}
198		if *profilesCSV == "" {
199			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles is required\n", benchCommandName())
200			return 2
201		}
202		if *harnessesCSV == "" {
203			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --harnesses is required\n", benchCommandName())
204			return 2
205		}
206	
207		// Parent context tied to interrupt/SIGTERM. When the bench process
208		// itself is signaled (Ctrl-C or `kill <pid>`) the parent ctx fires,
209		// propagating cancellation into every per-tuple Harbor invocation. Each
210		// Harbor child then gets SIGTERM via cmd.Cancel + WaitDelay, has 60s
211		// to tear down its docker compose stack, and exits cleanly. Without
212		// this, killing bench leaves Harbor children running with their task
213		// containers (the leak we saw earlier in the session).
214		parentCtx, stopSignals := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
215		defer stopSignals()
216	
217		wd := resolveWorkDir(*workDir)
218		subsetPath := *subset
219		if subsetPath == "" {
220			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, defaultMatrixSubset)
221		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(subsetPath) {
222			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, subsetPath)
223		}
224		// One-true-way defaults: when --out is unset, place the matrix summary
225		// inside the canonical fiz-tools-v<N>/ root. When --cells-root is unset,
226		// share the canonical /cells subtree. Tests that pass an explicit --out
227		// (typically a t.TempDir()) opt out via --cells-root staying empty,
228		// which falls through to the legacy in-place fallback (matrixTupleDir
229		// under outDir/cells/...). That preserves test isolation without
230		// leaving a stale "benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp>/" side path
231		// in production runs.
232		outDir := *out
233		if outDir == "" {
234			outDir = filepath.Join(resolveCanonicalFizRoot(wd), "matrix-runs", "matrix-"+time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z"))
235		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(outDir) {
236			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, outDir)
237		}
238		cellRootDir := *cellsRoot
239		if cellRootDir == "" && *out == "" {
240			// --out and --cells-root both unset: full canonical mode.
241			cellRootDir = filepath.Join(resolveCanonicalFizRoot(wd), "cells")
242		} else if cellRootDir != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(cellRootDir) {
243			cellRootDir = filepath.Join(wd, cellRootDir)
244		}
245	
246		profileIDs := splitCSV(*profilesCSV)
247		harnesses := splitCSV(*harnessesCSV)
248		if len(profileIDs) == 0 || len(harnesses) == 0 {
249			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles and --harnesses must not be empty\n", benchCommandName())
250			return 2
251		}
252	
253		subsetData, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
254		if err != nil {
255			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: load subset %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), subsetPath, err)
256			return 1
257		}
258		profiles, err := selectMatrixProfiles(wd, profileIDs)
259		if err != nil {
260			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
261			return 1
262		}
263		if err := os.MkdirAll(outDir, 0o750); err != nil {
264			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: create output dir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
265			return 1
266		}
267	
268		// Resolve harbor binary if tasks-dir is set (enables graded runs via Docker).
269		resolvedTasksDir := *tasksDir
270		if resolvedTasksDir != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(resolvedTasksDir) {
271			resolvedTasksDir = filepath.Join(wd, resolvedTasksDir)
272		}
273		harborBin := ""
274		if resolvedTasksDir != "" {
275			if bin, err := exec.LookPath("harbor"); err == nil {
276				harborBin = bin
277			} else {
278				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --tasks-dir set but harbor not found on PATH\n", benchCommandName())
279				return 1
280			}
281		}
282	
283		// Build the full list of tuples to run.
284		type tupleSpec struct {
285			harness string
286			prof    *profile.Profile
287			rep     int
288			task    termbenchSubsetEntry
289		}
290		var tuples []tupleSpec
291		for _, harness := range harnesses {
292			for _, prof := range profiles {
293				for rep := 1; rep <= *reps; rep++ {
294					for _, task := range subsetData.Tasks {
295						tuples = append(tuples, tupleSpec{harness, prof, rep, task})
296					}
297				}
298			}
299		}
300	
301		concurrency := *jobs
302		if concurrency < 1 {
303			concurrency = 1
304		}
305	
306		type tupleResult struct {
307			report  matrixRunReport
308			skipped bool
309			err     error
310		}
311	
312		results := make([]tupleResult, len(tuples))
313		sem := make(chan struct{}, concurrency)
314	
315		var (
316			mu              sync.Mutex
317			accumulatedCost float64
318			firstErr        error
319		)
320	
321		var wg sync.WaitGroup
322		for i, spec := range tuples {
323			wg.Add(1)
324			go func(i int, spec tupleSpec) {
325				defer wg.Done()
326				sem <- struct{}{}
327				defer func() { <-sem }()
328	
329				mu.Lock()
330				cost := accumulatedCost
331				mu.Unlock()
332	
333				report, skipped, err := runMatrixTuple(matrixTupleOptions{
334					workDir:           wd,
335					outDir:            outDir,
336					cellsRoot:         cellRootDir,
337					harness:           spec.harness,
338					profile:           spec.prof,
339					rep:               spec.rep,
340					task:              spec.task,
341					budgetUSD:         *budgetUSD,
342					perRunBudgetUSD:   *perRunBudgetUSD,
343					accumulatedCost:   cost,
344					resume:            *resume,
345					forceRerun:        *forceRerun,
346					retryBudgetHalted: *retryBudgetHalted,
347					retryInvalid:      *retryInvalid,
348					parentCtx:         parentCtx,
349					tasksDir:          resolvedTasksDir,
350					harborBin:         harborBin,
351					extraEnv:          extraEnvMap(extraEnv),
352				})
353	
354				mu.Lock()
355				results[i] = tupleResult{report, skipped, err}
356				if err != nil && firstErr == nil {
357					firstErr = err
358				}
359				if err == nil && !skipped {
360					accumulatedCost += report.CostUSD
361				}
362				mu.Unlock()
363			}(i, spec)
364		}
365		wg.Wait()
366	
367		if firstErr != nil {
368			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), firstErr)
369			return 1
370		}
371	
372		var runs []matrixRunReport
373		for _, r := range results {
374			runs = append(runs, r.report)
375		}
376	
377		sort.Slice(runs, func(i, j int) bool {
378			return matrixRunKey(runs[i]) < matrixRunKey(runs[j])
379		})
380		output := matrixOutput{
381			GeneratedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
382			SubsetPath:      subsetPath,
383			Profiles:        profileIDs,
384			Harnesses:       harnesses,
385			Reps:            *reps,
386			BudgetUSD:       *budgetUSD,
387			PerRunBudgetUSD: *perRunBudgetUSD,
388			Runs:            runs,
389			Cells:           summarizeMatrixCells(runs),
390			Notes: []string{
391				fmt.Sprintf("concurrency: --jobs %d", concurrency),
392				"adapter_module records the Python adapter path passed by the runner for the harness cell.",
393			},
394		}
395		matrixPath := filepath.Join(outDir, "matrix.json")
396		if err := writeJSONAtomic(matrixPath, output); err != nil {
397			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: write matrix.json: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
398			return 1
399		}
400		fmt.Printf("matrix results: %s\n", matrixPath)
401		return 0
402	}

425	func runMatrixTuple(opts matrixTupleOptions) (matrixRunReport, bool, error) {
426		cellDir := matrixTupleDirFor(opts.outDir, opts.cellsRoot, opts.harness, opts.profile, opts.rep, opts.task.ID)
427		reportPath := filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixReportName)
428		if !opts.forceRerun {
429			if existing, ok, err := loadExistingMatrixReport(reportPath); err != nil {
430				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
431			} else if ok && shouldSkipMatrixReport(existing, opts.resume, opts.retryBudgetHalted, opts.retryInvalid) {
432				return existing, true, nil
433			}
434		}
435	
436		release, err := acquireMatrixLock(filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixLockName))
437		if err != nil {
438			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
439		}
440		defer release()
441	
442		started := time.Now().UTC()
443		report := matrixRunReport{
444			Harness:         opts.harness,
445			ProfileID:       opts.profile.ID,
446			ProfilePath:     opts.profile.Path,
447			ProfileSnapshot: opts.profile.Versioning.Snapshot,
448			FizToolsVersion: fiztools.Version,
449			AdapterModule:   matrixAdapterModule(opts.harness),
450			HarborAgent:     filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("scripts", "benchmark", "harness_adapters", moduleFileName(opts.harness))) + ":Agent",
451			Rep:             opts.rep,
452			TaskID:          opts.task.ID,
453			Category:        opts.task.Category,
454			Difficulty:      opts.task.Difficulty,
455			OutputDir:       cellDir,
456			StartedAt:       started,
457			PricingSource:   profilePricingSource(opts.profile),
458			SamplingUsed:    samplingUsedFromProfile(opts.profile),
459			ModelServerInfo: queryModelServerInfo(opts.profile),
460		}
461	
462		if opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost >= opts.budgetUSD {
463			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
464			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
465			report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, false)
466			report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
467			if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
468				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
469			}
470			return report, false, nil
471		}
472	
473		workDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, "work")
474		if err := os.MkdirAll(workDir, 0o750); err != nil {
475			return matrixRunReport{}, false, fmt.Errorf("create tuple workdir: %w", err)
476		}
477	
478		if opts.harborBin != "" {
479			taskPath, err := resolveMatrixTaskPath(opts.tasksDir, opts.task.ID)
480			if err != nil {
481				report.ProcessOutcome = "install_fail_permanent"
482				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
483				report.Error = err.Error()
484			} else {
485				// Remove any stale Harbor job dir from a prior run before we
486				// invoke harbor again. Harbor (re)creates fiz-<task>-rep<N>/
487				// inside --jobs-dir; if a stale subdir exists from an earlier
488				// run with a different --tasks-dir, Harbor's config.json there
489				// references paths that may no longer exist (or that point at
490				// since-deleted timestamp dirs), and the trial fails with
491				// confusing errors. Wiping ensures a clean Harbor invocation
492				// every retry.
493				jobName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-rep%d", opts.harness, opts.task.ID, opts.rep)
494				staleJobDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, jobName)
495				if _, err := os.Stat(staleJobDir); err == nil {
496					_ = os.RemoveAll(staleJobDir)
497				}
498				harborResult, err := runMatrixHarbor(harborRunOpts{
499					harborBin: opts.harborBin,
500					taskPath:  taskPath,
501					harness:   opts.harness,
502					profile:   opts.profile,
503					jobsDir:   cellDir,
504					jobName:   jobName,
505					repoRoot:  opts.workDir,
506					extraEnv:  opts.extraEnv,
507					parentCtx: opts.parentCtx,
508				})
509				if err != nil {
510					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
511					report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
512					report.Error = err.Error()
513				} else {
514					report.ExitCode = harborResult.exitCode
515					report.Error = harborResult.errText
516					seconds := harborResult.wallSeconds
517					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
518					if harborResult.inputTokens != nil {
519						report.InputTokens = harborResult.inputTokens
520					}
521					if harborResult.outputTokens != nil {
522						report.OutputTokens = harborResult.outputTokens
523					}
524					if harborResult.turns != nil {
525						report.Turns = harborResult.turns
526					}
527					report.CostUSD = harborResult.costUSD
528					if harborResult.reward != nil {
529						report.Reward = harborResult.reward
530						report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
531						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
532					} else if harborResult.exitCode != 0 {
533						report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
534						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
535					} else {
536						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
537						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
538					}
539				}
540				// Read session-jsonl signals (terminated_mid_work + had_llm_request
541				// + reasoning_tokens) from the trial's session jsonl. The harbor
542				// agent (FizeauAgent) writes to <cellDir>/<jobName>/<trial-hash>/
543				// agent/sessions/svc-*.jsonl; glob for the newest since the
544				// trial-hash isn't known up front. Mirrors backfill-terminated-
545				// mid-work.py.
546				tmw, hadReq, reasoning := readSessionSignalsFromCell(filepath.Join(cellDir, jobName))
547				if tmw != nil {
548					report.TerminatedMidWork = tmw
549				}
550				if reasoning != nil {
551					report.ReasoningTokens = reasoning
552				}
553				report.HadLLMRequest = &hadReq
554			}
555		} else {
556			result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
557			if err != nil {
558				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
559				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
560				report.Error = err.Error()
561			} else {
562				report.Command = result.Command.Argv
563				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
564				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
565				report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
566				if result.ExitCode != 0 {
567					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
568					report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
569				}
570				applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
571				if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
572					seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
573					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
574				}
575			}
576		}
577		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
578			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
579		}
580		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
581			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
582		}

684	func runMatrixHarbor(opts harborRunOpts) (harborRunResult, error) {
685		started := time.Now()
686	
687		apiKeyEnv := opts.profile.Provider.APIKeyEnv
688		if override := strings.TrimSpace(opts.extraEnv["FIZEAU_API_KEY_ENV"]); override != "" {
689			apiKeyEnv = override
690		}
691		apiKeyVal := resolveMatrixAPIKey(opts.repoRoot, opts.profile, apiKeyEnv)
692	
693		args := []string{"run", "--yes", "--path", opts.taskPath}
694		args = append(args, harborAgentArgs(opts.harness)...)
695		args = append(args,
696			"--model", opts.profile.Provider.Model,
697			"--jobs-dir", opts.jobsDir,
698			"--job-name", opts.jobName,
699		)
700		if truthyEnv("HARBOR_FORCE_BUILD") {
701			args = append(args, "--force-build")
702		}
703		// Agent timeout multiplier resolution order (later wins):
704		//   1. Profile YAML's agent_timeout_multiplier (per-lane default)
705		//   2. HARBOR_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER env var (per-invocation override)
706		// Slow local engines (oMLX, vLLM-int4) bake their multiplier into the
707		// profile so individual sweeps don't have to remember to set the env
708		// var. Without this, those lanes truncate mid-tool-call on hard tasks.
709		multiplier := ""
710		if m := opts.profile.AgentTimeoutMultiplier; m > 0 {
711			multiplier = strconv.FormatFloat(m, 'f', -1, 64)
712		}
713		if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("HARBOR_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER")); env != "" {
714			multiplier = env
715		}
716		if multiplier != "" {
717			args = append(args, "--agent-timeout-multiplier", multiplier)
718		}
719		// Do not pass actual API key values through Harbor --ae args. Harbor
720		// includes those args in process listings and exception logs. The Fizeau
721		// Harbor agent resolves FIZEAU_API_KEY_ENV from the Harbor process
722		// environment instead.
723		// Pass provider config so Harbor agents can configure the model endpoint.
724		args = append(args,
725			"--ae", "FIZEAU_BASE_URL="+opts.profile.Provider.BaseURL,
726			"--ae", "FIZEAU_MODEL="+opts.profile.Provider.Model,
727			"--ae", "FIZEAU_PROVIDER="+fizeauProviderEnv(opts.profile),
728		)
729		for _, kv := range envPairs(opts.extraEnv) {
730			args = append(args, "--ae", kv)
731		}
732		// Forward sampling params so fiz reads them via FIZEAU_* env overrides.
733		for _, kv := range samplingEnvPairs(opts.profile) {
734			args = append(args, "--ae", kv)
735		}
736	
737		// Derive from the parent ctx so SIGTERM/SIGINT on the bench process
738		// itself propagates into this Harbor invocation and triggers cmd.Cancel.
739		parentCtx := opts.parentCtx
740		if parentCtx == nil {
741			parentCtx = context.Background()
742		}
743		// Process-level cap on the harbor invocation. This must exceed the
744		// max possible effective per-trial agent timeout (task base × profile
745		// agent_timeout_multiplier) plus harbor's environment/grading overhead,
746		// or the cap kills the run before harbor can timeout the agent
747		// gracefully. TB-2.1 task bases are <=1200s; vidar's 3.7x multiplier
748		// pushes the effective ceiling to ~74min. 150min leaves headroom for
749		// future profile bumps and non-trivial environment setup.
750		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parentCtx, 150*time.Minute)
751		defer cancel()
752		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, opts.harborBin, args...) // #nosec G204 G702 -- harborBin is a validated binary path from config
753		// Send SIGTERM (not the default SIGKILL) on context cancel so Harbor's
754		// `--delete` finalizer can tear down the per-trial docker compose stack.
755		// WaitDelay gives the cleanup 60s before we hard-kill; without this the
756		// task containers leak and pile up across sweeps (observed: 32 leftover
757		// containers after a 21h run, leading to docker-compose port/IP exhaustion).
758		cmd.Cancel = func() error { return cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM) }
759		cmd.WaitDelay = 60 * time.Second
760		// Add repo root to PYTHONPATH so harbor_adapters modules resolve.
761		env := os.Environ()
762		pythonPath := opts.repoRoot
763		for i, e := range env {
764			if strings.HasPrefix(e, "PYTHONPATH=") {
765				pythonPath = opts.repoRoot + string(os.PathListSeparator) + e[len("PYTHONPATH="):]
766				env[i] = "PYTHONPATH=" + pythonPath
767				pythonPath = ""
768				break
769			}
770		}
771		if pythonPath != "" {
772			env = append(env, "PYTHONPATH="+pythonPath)
773		}
774		env = append(env,
775			"FIZEAU_BASE_URL="+opts.profile.Provider.BaseURL,
776			"FIZEAU_MODEL="+opts.profile.Provider.Model,
777			"FIZEAU_PROVIDER="+fizeauProviderEnv(opts.profile),
778		)
779		if apiKeyEnv != "" && apiKeyVal != "" {
780			env = append(env, apiKeyEnv+"="+apiKeyVal)
781		}
782		if apiKeyVal != "" {
783			env = append(env, "FIZEAU_API_KEY="+apiKeyVal)
784		}
785		for _, kv := range envPairs(opts.extraEnv) {
786			env = append(env, kv)
787		}
788		for _, kv := range samplingEnvPairs(opts.profile) {
789			env = append(env, kv)
790		}
791		if harness := strings.TrimSpace(opts.extraEnv["FIZEAU_HARNESS"]); harness != "" {
792			env = append(env, "HARBOR_FIZEAU_HARNESS="+harness)
793		}
794		cmd.Env = env
795		cmd.Dir = opts.repoRoot
796	
797		var combined bytes.Buffer
798		cmd.Stdout = &combined
799		cmd.Stderr = &combined
800		runErr := cmd.Run()
801		wall := time.Since(started).Seconds()
802	
803		exitCode := 0
804		if runErr != nil {
805			var ee *exec.ExitError
806			if errors.As(runErr, &ee) {
807				exitCode = ee.ExitCode()
808			} else {
809				return harborRunResult{}, runErr
810			}
811		}
812	
813		// Find reward.txt written by the Harbor verifier.
814		var reward *int
815		jobOutDir := filepath.Join(opts.jobsDir, opts.jobName)
816		entries, _ := os.ReadDir(jobOutDir)
817		for _, e := range entries {
818			rewardFile := filepath.Join(jobOutDir, e.Name(), "verifier", "reward.txt")
819			data, err := os.ReadFile(rewardFile) // #nosec G304 -- rewardFile is under runner-owned output dir
820			if err == nil {
821				val, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(data)))
822				if err == nil {
823					reward = &val
824				}
825				break
826			}
827		}
828	
829		errText := harborFailureText(jobOutDir, combined.String())
830		if exitCode == 0 && reward != nil && classifyMatrixInvalidText(errText) == "" {
831			errText = ""
832		}
833		inputTokens, outputTokens, turns, costUSD := readHarborTrajectoryMetrics(jobOutDir)
834		return harborRunResult{
835			reward:       reward,
836			exitCode:     exitCode,
837			wallSeconds:  wall,
838			errText:      errText,
839			inputTokens:  inputTokens,
840			outputTokens: outputTokens,
841			turns:        turns,
842			costUSD:      costUSD,
843		}, nil
844	}

846	func harborFailureText(jobOutDir, combined string) string {
847		var parts []string
848		if s := strings.TrimSpace(combined); s != "" {
849			parts = append(parts, s)
850		}
851		_ = filepath.WalkDir(jobOutDir, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
852			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
853				return nil
854			}
855			base := filepath.Base(path)
856			if base != "fiz.txt" && base != "exception.txt" {
857				return nil
858			}
859			data, err := os.ReadFile(path) // #nosec G304 G122 -- path is under runner-owned output dir; WalkDir TOCTOU acceptable for postprocess scan
860			if err != nil {
861				return nil
862			}
863			text := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
864			if text != "" {
865				parts = append(parts, text)
866			}
867			return nil
868		})
869		text := redactBenchmarkSecrets(strings.Join(parts, "\n"))
870		if len(text) > 4000 {
871			// Keep the tail: Python tracebacks place the actual exception
872			// (e.g. "RuntimeError: Docker compose command failed ...") at the end,
873			// and the framework noise above it is what we'd rather drop.
874			text = text[len(text)-4000:]
875		}
876		return strings.TrimSpace(text)
877	}

879	func redactBenchmarkSecrets(text string) string {
880		if text == "" {
881			return ""
882		}
883		patterns := []*regexp.Regexp{
884			regexp.MustCompile(`sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`),
885			regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(OPENAI_API_KEY|OPENROUTER_API_KEY|FIZEAU_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)=\S+`),
886			regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(api_key:\s*)\S+`),
887		}
888		out := text
889		for _, re := range patterns {
890			out = re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(out, func(match string) string {
891				if strings.Contains(match, "=") {
892					key, _, _ := strings.Cut(match, "=")
893					return key + "=<redacted>"
894				}
895				if strings.Contains(match, ":") {
896					key, _, _ := strings.Cut(match, ":")
897					return key + ": <redacted>"
898				}
899				return "<redacted>"
900			})
901		}
902		return out
903	}

1217	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
1218		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
1219			return nil, err
1220		}
1221		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
1222		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
1223		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
1224			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600) // #nosec G304 -- path is the matrix lock file path
1225			if err == nil {
1226				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
1227					_ = f.Close()
1228					_ = os.Remove(path)
1229					return nil, werr
1230				}
1231				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
1232					_ = os.Remove(path)
1233					return nil, err
1234				}
1235				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
1236			}
1237			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
1238				return nil, err
1239			}
1240			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
1241			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
1242				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
1243					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
1244				}
1245				continue
1246			}
1247			pid := "unknown"
1248			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
1249				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
1250			}
1251			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
1252		}
1253		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
1254	}

1336	// readSessionSignalsFromCell streams the trial's session jsonl and
1337	// returns four signals:
1338	//
1339	//	tmw           : terminated_mid_work — true if last llm.response had
1340	//	                finish_reason in (tool_calls, length, function_call);
1341	//	                false on (stop, end_turn); nil when no llm.response.
1342	//	hadLLMRequest : true when the agent issued at least one llm.request,
1343	//	                whether or not a response came back.
1344	//	reasoningTokens: per-cell sum of usage.reasoning across all llm.response
1345	//	                events. Returns nil when the provider doesn't expose
1346	//	                reasoning_tokens at all (so absent vs explicit-zero are
1347	//	                distinguishable). Captured from data.usage.reasoning
1348	//	                (fizeau-emitted) or data.usage.completion_tokens_details
1349	//	                .reasoning_tokens (raw upstream OpenAI shape).
1350	//
1351	// The combination distinguishes three failure shapes:
1352	//   - tmw set true|false  → model attempted (real graded result)
1353	//   - tmw nil + hadReq true → request fired but no response (provider hang
1354	//     or stream error). Tag invalid_provider.
1355	//   - tmw nil + hadReq false → never even sent a request (setup failure
1356	//     before reaching the model).
1357	//
1358	// jobDir = <cellDir>/<jobName>; harbor writes to
1359	// <jobDir>/<trial-hash>/agent/sessions/svc-*.jsonl.
1360	func readSessionSignalsFromCell(jobDir string) (tmw *bool, hadLLMRequest bool, reasoningTokens *int) {
1361		matches, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(jobDir, "*", "agent", "sessions", "svc-*.jsonl"))
1362		if err != nil || len(matches) == 0 {
1363			return nil, false, nil
1364		}
1365		// Newest by mtime — matches the trial we just ran.
1366		sessPath := matches[0]
1367		if len(matches) > 1 {
1368			newest, _ := os.Stat(sessPath)
1369			for _, m := range matches[1:] {
1370				st, err := os.Stat(m)
1371				if err == nil && (newest == nil || st.ModTime().After(newest.ModTime())) {
1372					sessPath = m
1373					newest = st
1374				}
1375			}
1376		}
1377		f, err := os.Open(sessPath) // #nosec G304 -- jobDir is a benchmark output path
1378		if err != nil {
1379			return nil, false, nil
1380		}
1381		defer f.Close()
1382		var lastFinish string
1383		var reasoningSum int
1384		var sawReasoning bool
1385		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
1386		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 1024*1024), 16*1024*1024)
1387		for scanner.Scan() {
1388			var ev struct {
1389				Type string `json:"type"`
1390				Data struct {
1391					FinishReason string `json:"finish_reason"`
1392					Usage        struct {
1393						Reasoning               int `json:"reasoning"`
1394						CompletionTokensDetails struct {
1395							ReasoningTokens int `json:"reasoning_tokens"`
1396						} `json:"completion_tokens_details"`
1397					} `json:"usage"`
1398				} `json:"data"`
1399			}
1400			if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &ev); err != nil {
1401				continue
1402			}
1403			switch ev.Type {
1404			case "llm.request":
1405				hadLLMRequest = true
1406			case "llm.response":
1407				if ev.Data.FinishReason != "" {
1408					lastFinish = ev.Data.FinishReason
1409				}
1410				// Prefer fizeau's normalized field; fall back to the raw OpenAI shape
1411				// if a provider passes raw upstream usage through unchanged.
1412				tokens := ev.Data.Usage.Reasoning
1413				if tokens == 0 {
1414					tokens = ev.Data.Usage.CompletionTokensDetails.ReasoningTokens
1415				}
1416				if tokens > 0 {
1417					sawReasoning = true
1418					reasoningSum += tokens
1419				}
1420			}
1421		}
1422		switch lastFinish {
1423		case "tool_calls", "length", "function_call":
1424			t := true
1425			tmw = &t
1426		case "stop", "end_turn":
1427			fv := false
1428			tmw = &fv
1429		}
1430		if sawReasoning {
1431			reasoningTokens = &reasoningSum
1432		}
1433		return tmw, hadLLMRequest, reasoningTokens
1434	}

1497				a.invalidCounts[invalidClass]++
1498			} else {
1499				a.cell.NValid++
1500				if run.Reward != nil {

1502					a.rewards = append(a.rewards, float64(*run.Reward))

1509			a.inputTokens += intValue(run.InputTokens)

1511			a.cachedTokens += intValue(run.CachedInputTokens)
1512			a.retriedTokens += intValue(run.RetriedInputTokens)
1513		}
1514		cells := make([]matrixCell, 0, len(byKey))
1515		for _, a := range byKey {
1516			a.cell.CostUSD = a.cost
1517			a.cell.InputTokens = a.inputTokens

1519			a.cell.CachedTokens = a.cachedTokens

1524				sd := sampleSD(a.rewards, mean)
1525				a.cell.MeanReward = &mean
1526				a.cell.SDReward = &sd
1527			}

1529		}

1531			if cells[i].Harness == cells[j].Harness {
1532				return cells[i].ProfileID < cells[j].ProfileID
1533			}
